Retreat 2026

The biggest event of the year

August 12–15, 2026

The highlight of the guild year. Four days away with nationally recognized instructors, your favorite projects, and a whole community of stitchers — all in one place. It's exclusively for members, and it's worth being one.

Where we meet

Most Guild events and workshops are held at Minnesota Valley Unitarian Universalist Fellowship (MVUUF) in Bloomington. Some events travel — the venue for each is listed with the event on the calendar.
